snippet.title: WARMACHINE: ROGUE-SCOUT — Official Alpha Trailer | Anime Mecha Game
snippet.description:
The war has only just begun.

Warmachine: Rogue-Scout is a tactical anime mecha game where you recruit pilots, collect and upgrade powerful Warmachines, and deploy your fleet across story campaigns, ranked multiplayer, survival challenges, Fighting Pits, patrols and more.

This first alpha promo offers a glimpse at the world, pilots and machines we are building. Warmachine: Rogue-Scout is still in active development, so visuals, systems and content will continue to evolve.

Wishlist and follow the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5006180/Warmachine_RogueScout/
Join Early Access: https://rogue-scout.carrd.co/

Join us early, share your feedback and help shape the future of the game.
Discord: https://discord.gg/GpyB7jmrKT
